name: Sarangkot sunrise hill
why: Up the hill behind Lakeside to the paragliding take-off of Sarangkot, where the sun lights Dhaulagiri, Annapurna and Machhapuchhre above the lake.
book: Small ticket at the viewpoint. A taxi can take you up for sunrise and you walk down.
water: Tea shops and lodges at the top.
dangers: Steep path in the dark: carry a headlamp.

points.name: Lakeside, Pokhara
points.note: The hotel district on the east shore of Phewa Lake.

points.name: Sarangkot viewpoint
points.note: A 1,600 m hilltop of tea shops and paragliders, the Annapurna range in front.
